_comment: Each entry waives one baseline line that no longer exists anywhere in the skill tree. Replace every REASON with why losing this line is safe. Editing the line's wording changes its hash and revokes the waiver.

waived.00bbd60131510c5b: Rewritten in place, not deleted. The sentence '**When the gate says clean and the pixels say broken, the PIXELS win.**' still opens the replacement paragraph, word for word. Only the clause after it changed, because the reason it is true changed.
waived.177ecdff8385248a: The claim survives, restated. Paint order is still named as the fault class that keeps proving the rule. The old wording said the lint 'does not model paint order' as an absolute, and that is now false: OCCLUSION, RULE THROUGH TEXT and TEXT NOT VISIBLE all reason about it. Leaving the absolute in place would teach a limit the tool no longer has.
waived.2c153eb8875646a6: The measurement it carried is preserved and extended. The footer-hairline-over-a-sources-line case is still cited by name, now beside the two further real decks that proved the same class: a 150-tile field erasing a caption, and a dashed rule of 40 boxes struck through a footnote.
waived.ec03c69ba6a39f22: Same content, made useful. OCCLUSION and RULE THROUGH TEXT are still named, but no longer described only as 'two new hard checks' — the replacement says WHAT changed about them (coverage is now measured as a union, so something assembled from many small parts cannot slip a per-shape threshold), which is the part a reader needs in order to generalise.
waived.8494159648662c1a: Extended in place, nothing dropped. PRE-FLIGHT 9's whole original sentence — squint each slide, first look lands on the named hero, 3-4 hierarchy levels survive the blur — is the first half of the replacement, word for word. The item gained a second half (name the anchor of every label, list the slides) and so gained a word in its title, which is what changed the hash.
waived.e25e602954d2742b: The 'a net, not a proof' caveat is kept verbatim in the replacement. The sentence it belonged to now also introduces TEXT NOT VISIBLE and, more importantly, the reason the old design failed: it enumerated CAUSES, which are unbounded, instead of measuring the effect. That rationale is the generalisable lesson and did not exist in the baseline.
waived.7fb7b37b96841616: Extended in place. The line is byte-identical except that the enumerated field list now reads `boldness: / signature move: / logo plan: / density:` — `density:` was added because the audit found the density plan line existed in checkpoint-convention.md alone and was named by no layer-1 list, so nothing ever asked the art director to produce it. Adding a name to a list of names is the whole diff.
waived.ea2465c906842976: Extended in place. The sentence enumerating what the planner subagent is handed gained `and the **search cap:** below` — the same audit found the search-budget rule stated at Step 5 while the fan-out it governs is dispatched at Step 1, so the dispatched agent was exactly as uninformed as during the incident. Everything before that clause is unchanged.
waived.db4c584bd4e275cf: Corrected in place, not deleted. `--example` never covered 'any form component' — 23 of ~59 had scaffolds, and the tool answered 'it is a primitive — you supply the geometry' for waterfall/gantt/dumbbell_board, the three named in Step 4's 🔴 do-NOT-hand-roll rule. The line now says 'every form component that has a scaffold' and states what an unscaffolded one prints instead.
waived.02b8cea2c7eb28fa: Same sentence as db4c584bd4e275cf, re-wrapped by the correction. No clause was dropped.
waived.2d6d33089ab4b0b7: Deleted as a genuine duplicate. The a886c1a re-inlining refactor dropped the hub_spoke/hub_spokes NB into a parenthetical and stranded its tail, leaving 'the / focal path can carry emphasis instead);' — a second copy of the clause that still stands intact at the head of the same sentence, closed by a paren that opens nothing.
waived.810509406f294945: Same stranded tail as 2d6d33089ab4b0b7. `diagram_island` and its gloss survive verbatim on the joined line.
waived.d2db60a3835c0ec6: Corrected in place: 'on five things' -> 'on six things'. lint_layout emits six CRITICAL codes (OFF_CANVAS, OVERFLOW, TEXT_OVERLAP, CONNECTOR_IN_BOX, RULE_THROUGH_TEXT, CJK_NO_EA); the sentence already enumerated six. The count was the error, not the list.
waived.e40d0a664ea7df2c: Re-wrapped, not deleted: the CJK_NO_EA clause survives verbatim one word later, now opening 'coordinate), and **CJK runs...**' after its duplicate was removed.
waived.6705ffabb3b17298: Deleted as a verbatim duplicate. This clause and the two lines under it repeated the CJK_NO_EA entry word for word inside one sentence; the surviving copy is unchanged.
waived.b8aec1c321a78209: Extended in place. PRE-FLIGHT 12(a) said '>~40%' while the Step-2 form-ledger gate, the critic, form-selection.md, review-rubrics.md, design-principles.md and the addendum all say '~40-50%'. Widened to the shared band so a 45% family cannot pass Step 2 and then fail a post-build tick with no justification arm.
waived.01f915a8155715c9: Replaced with the shape the gate actually accepts. `{"critic": {"waived": "<reason>"}}` is REJECTED by render_deck.py, which requires `waived_category` (one of four kinds) and `inline_ran` for no-dispatch-on-host. The documented shape could not be used; the replacement is a fenced JSON block plus the four categories.
waived.9486e3fed3e8d1f7: Split by the correction in 01f915a8155715c9. 'This file is the hand-off's evidence, not a formality: the model that' survives verbatim as its own line after the inserted JSON block.
waived.91ddb27c7a973d53: Corrected in place: 'the design plan's four fields' -> 'the whole `design_plan` block enumerated above'. DESIGN_FIELDS has been eight since icon_family/palette/type_scale/signature_proof were added; a count-free phrasing cannot go stale on the ninth.
waived.03df5c03692482ca: Extended in place. The logo `n/a` reason set gained `third-party assessment` — a full member of the set (the 🔴 row 20 lines below decides it BEFORE the search and a found logo does not overturn it), which the closed three-token list silently excluded.
waived.7a03eadce06542db: Extended in place: the signature-move line now carries its `carried_by:` clause, so the checkpoint shows the 2-3 slides where the idea does structural work. The Step-2 gate already required carried_by; the checkpoint that gets the user's OK never showed it.
waived.35faf4c886b5a48a: Same sentence as the carried_by extension, re-wrapped. The veto rationale survives verbatim with 'or a risk that lives on exactly one slide' added.
waived.48f3ba454acb905d: Re-wrapped by the third-party-assessment token insertion; the motif-line clause survives word for word on the following line.
waived.39382d960e890687: Extended in place. The STRANGER TEST has FOUR arms, not three — removal is first-class and usually the better fix (slide-design §1), and the 'a reading that DEFERS is not a reading' tell was in checkpoint-convention.md but not here.
waived.fdcdcf58c645c094: Corrected in place. The line named only branch (c)'s `direction gate:` and dropped branch (d)'s `style gate:`, though checkpoint-convention.md requires BOTH and calls a (c)/(d) checkpoint with no gate line 'not ready'.
waived.685e0bdcb7ee5677: Corrected in place: one dial was stated in two opposite directions four lines apart — the lint measures INK, the sentence compared it to a WHITESPACE target, and the role bands below are occupancy. Now stated as occupancy throughout, matching what the gate reads.
waived.ffff9d6e610af000: Corrected in place. A THIRD call-shape contract was added (picture() takes the path SECOND, which broke three scaffolds while they were being written), so 'the two that have actually gone wrong' became the same stale-count defect this batch exists to fix. Now 'the three'; the run-tuple and RGBColor clauses survive verbatim.
waived.4a347f386d8f868c: Corrected in place. waived.1ad20de3ea1a7b4e: Corrected in place. The backstop column is supposed to name WHAT CATCHES YOU if you skip the read; this cell restated the file's own thesis ('auto means you choose, not skip'), which is not an artifact, a field or a check. Replaced with the two real backstops, which existed and were simply not cited: the hand-off's delegated-picks recap cannot be written without the file, and Step 4's 'Gates never collapse' is where a skipped one surfaces. Inventing a backstop would be worse than none; naming the real one is the fix.
waived.fa20e6696130a35e: Corrected in place — a live contradiction, not a reword. Step 1 (L356) says 'about half of what REMAINS, not half of the original cap'; this line said 'half the session cap', which is the thing Step 1 explicitly forbids, so the two entry points sized the same fan-out differently. Step 1's wording wins on the merits (the cap is session-scoped and does not reset between decks) and on provenance (its clause was added 2026-07-27 in c3609c5, an audit commit correcting exactly this). Both copies now read the same and say so.

waived.9b096a19ed3ec7f6: Re-addressed in place, not deleted. Every operative clause survives verbatim: 'every 🔴 MUST must be *wired into a gate artifact*', the six-item gate list, 'A MUST that lives only in reference prose is advisory in practice - history shows it gets missed', and the 'deterministic (lint) > required-field > checklist > prose' ranking. Only the scoping parenthetical changed. '(for anyone evolving this skill)' told a RUNTIME reader the block was someone else's business, but two of its three sentences ARE runtime instructions - how to weigh an unbacked MUST met in one of the ~30 reference files, and how to rank conflicting gates - and the block sits inside 'Rule-strength vocabulary (how to read the rules below)', i.e. the reading key, not a maintainers section. Step 0's scope guard also declares 'audit or review this skill/repo' an in-scope invocation: that is exactly the run that would skip a block addressed to someone else. The new wording names both audiences.
